nodes.title: MiniMax H3 Image to Video    二次使用

widgets_values:
10 seconds video, 9:16 vertical format, realistic smartphone-recorded magical outfit transformation video.
<ref_image_0>: reference, adult female character, preserve the exact face, hairstyle, body proportions, body shape, height, and identity from the reference image. The transformation changes clothing only. Keep the same character appearance before and after transformation.

Scene:
Inside a real moving subway carriage, not a station platform.
The subway layout must be realistic:
the woman is seated on a long side bench attached to the carriage wall,
a subway window is directly behind her,
the central walking aisle is in front of her,
vertical poles and overhead hand straps are placed naturally,
the train is visibly in motion with natural carriage vibration and window reflections,
the environment clearly reads as a real operating subway carriage.
Do not create unrealistic subway geometry.
Do not place seats in the middle of the aisle.
Do not make the carriage look oversized, empty, or like a studio set.

Seated pose and spatial logic:
The woman sits on the side bench next to the window, but she is not sitting sideways like a normal passenger.
She is seated near the front edge of the bench and has deliberately turned her seated posture to face the camera directly.
Her knees point toward the camera.
Her hips are rotated toward the camera.
Her shoulders and chest face the camera frontally.
This must read visually as a front-facing seated pose, not a side-facing passenger pose, not a profile, and not a three-quarter side view.

Camera position:
The camera operator is standing directly in front of her at close conversational distance in the nearby aisle space, about 0.8 to 1 meter away, facing her directly.
Use a close front-facing medium-full framing.
The woman must appear large and clear in frame.
Frame her from head to knees, or from head to upper shins, so her face, upper body, seated posture, legs, and overall silhouette are clearly visible.
Do not use a far shot.
Do not place the camera at the other end of the carriage.
Do not use a wide establishing shot.

Camera style:
realistic vertical smartphone video,
slight handheld movement,
natural autofocus adjustment,
realistic phone exposure,
slight smartphone wide-angle distortion,
casual real-world social-media recording style.

Story logic:
There are two phones.
The woman is holding her own phone with both hands and casually looking at it.
She is initially unaware of what is happening.
The camera operator’s phone appears only in the lower right foreground and occupies a small part of the frame, around 10 to 15 percent of the image area.
This phone is used to browse and select outfit options.
The phone screen must display outfit choices only.
Do not show any people, models, mannequins, or character photos on the phone screen.
Show only clothing thumbnails / outfit cards / apparel options.
The seated woman remains the visual main subject.
The phone must not dominate the frame and must not make the woman appear small.

Outfit selection:
The operator casually scrolls through several trendy, stylish swimsuit outfit options and randomly selects one.
The selected final outfit is a black lace trimmed fashion swimsuit.

Target transformed outfit:
A black lace trimmed fashion swimsuit with delicate lace texture, elegant lace details, and a fashionable swimwear design.
The outfit looks trendy and visually striking.
It must remain a swimsuit, not transform into other clothing types.
All body areas are fully covered, no exposed skin in sensitive areas.

Body consistency requirements:
The transformation changes clothing only.
Keep the exact same face, hairstyle, body shape, body proportions, silhouette, and identity from the reference image.
Do not change height, weight, chest size, hip size, leg length, or physique.
No body distortion.
No identity drift.

Transformation effect:
The transformation must be continuous, not instant.
A magical glowing circular scanning ring appears around her feet and moves upward.
The effect transforms the clothing step by step from bottom to top:
feet,
legs,
waist,
upper body.
Where the glowing light passes, the original outfit smoothly changes into the selected black lace trimmed fashion swimsuit.
Use:
soft glowing particles,
transparent light waves,
circular scanning energy,
smooth magical fabric transition.
No sudden full-body swap.
No teleportation.
No sudden position changes.

View constraints:
No side view.
No profile view.
No three-quarter side passenger pose.
No distant across-the-carriage shot.
No overly wide subway composition.
The final visual priority is:

1. the woman’s front-facing seated pose,
2. her face and body clarity,
3. the transformation action,
4. the realistic subway environment.

Motion requirements:
The woman remains seated in the same seat the whole time.
She does not stand up.
She does not walk.
The camera operator remains standing directly in front of her.
The final reaction happens while she is still seated.

00:00 - 00:02.2
The video begins inside the real moving subway carriage.
The adult female character is already seated naturally on the side bench next to the window.
She wears the original outfit from ref_image_0.
She is looking down at her own phone with both hands, unaware.
The camera operator stands directly in front of her at close distance.
The operator’s phone enters the lower right foreground and shows several outfit selection thumbnails.
The phone screen shows clothing only, no people.
The composition remains close and front-facing, clearly showing the seated woman.

00:02.2 - 00:04.0
The operator scrolls through the outfit choices on the foreground phone.
All visible options are trendy, stylish swimsuit designs.
The operator casually selects one option at random.
The selected final outfit is the black lace trimmed fashion swimsuit.
Immediately after the tap, magical glowing particles appear around the seated woman.
She keeps looking at her own phone and does not notice yet.

00:04.0 - 00:07.2
A glowing circular scanning ring appears near her feet and starts moving upward.
As the glowing ring rises, her original clothing gradually transforms into the selected black lace trimmed fashion swimsuit.
The lower body transforms first,
then the waist,
then the upper body.
The transformation is smooth and clearly visible.
The woman remains seated naturally in the same position and continues holding her own phone, still mostly unaware.
The camera stays directly in front of her at close distance, keeping her clear and large in frame.

00:07.2 - 00:10.0
The transformation finishes and the magical light disappears.
The woman finally notices something is different.
She lowers her own phone.
She looks down and visually scans her changed outfit on herself with clear surprise.
She checks her body and clothing briefly while staying seated.
Then she raises her head and looks directly toward the camera.
Her final expression is natural shock and surprised disbelief, like she just realized the camera operator played a playful couple’s prank on her.
The video ends with her still seated on the subway bench, wearing the black lace trimmed fashion swimsuit, looking directly at the camera.

overall_soundscape:
real moving subway carriage ambience,
train movement noise,
rail vibration,
soft passenger background sounds,
phone tapping sounds,
subtle magical transformation sound effect,
natural carriage echo.
